narrative_prose: Inside The First Forge, Silas tightened his grip on the insulated baton as the blistering amber flash of a magnetic surge painted the sweltering, soot-stained walls. The deafening hum of failing containment protocols rattled the brass tools along the workbench, while the sharp, metallic tang of ionized ozone and the thick scent of molten copper completely saturated the heavy air. Realizing the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea would soon CONSUME the delicate core alignment, he braced himself to DEFEND the fractured thermal baffle and firmly pressed the baton into Hector's waiting hand, signaling the prodigy to ATTRACT the chaotic polarity away from the failing grid.
